name: aaron_marketing_skills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the aaron_marketing_skills capability.

prompts.name: skill_invocation
prompts.template: Apply the {marketing_discipline} marketing skill using command {command} with the following input data: {input_data}.
prompts.use_case: Developing SEO strategies optimized with EEAT and citation validation

prompts.name: audit_request
prompts.template: Run the {command} auditor gate to evaluate the marketing output generated for {marketing_discipline} with data: {input_data}.
prompts.use_case: Running influencer marketing campaigns with performance auditing

prompts.name: strategy_development
prompts.template: Develop a marketing strategy for the {marketing_discipline} discipline focusing on optimizing {specific_goal} with inputs: {input_data}.
prompts.use_case: Creating paid advertisements healthcare ROAS-focused audits
